healthcare_have_experience_with.question: Do you have experience with healthcare SEO?
healthcare_have_experience_with.answer: Yes. AVR Web Consulting has run SEO and AI visibility programmes for healthcare businesses across India, the USA, UK, UAE and Europe. We work to patients, caregivers and referring practitioners search behaviour and a typical same day to 30 days decision cycle rather than applying a generic checklist.

healthcare_long_healthcare_seo.question: How long does healthcare SEO take to show results?
healthcare_long_healthcare_seo.answer: Technical and on-page fixes usually move impressions within 3–6 weeks. Meaningful ranking and enquiry growth typically lands in months 3–6, with compounding gains after that. Sites with existing authority move faster than new domains.

healthcare_healthcare_seo_cost.question: What does healthcare SEO cost at AVR Web Consulting?
healthcare_healthcare_seo_cost.answer: Programmes start at $100/month for focused local or single-service work and scale with content volume, number of locations and competition. We quote after an initial audit so the scope matches the opportunity, not a template.

healthcare_which_keywords_matter.question: Which keywords matter most for healthcare?
healthcare_which_keywords_matter.answer: The highest-value clusters are "<specialty> near me" and "best <specialist> in <city>"; symptom, treatment and cost questions; insurance and appointment logistics. We prioritise commercial intent first, then supporting informational content that feeds both search rankings and AI answers.

healthcare_get_healthcare_brands.question: How do you get healthcare brands mentioned by ChatGPT and Perplexity?
healthcare_get_healthcare_brands.answer: Health answers are held to a higher citation bar. Sites with named, credentialed authors and structured medical markup are the ones AI systems are willing to quote.

healthcare_structured_data_implement.question: What structured data do you implement for healthcare?
healthcare_structured_data_implement.answer: We deploy MedicalClinic + Physician + FAQPage + LocalBusiness alongside sitewide Organization and BreadcrumbList markup, validated against Google's Rich Results Test and kept in sync as content changes.

healthcare_also_handle_paid.question: Do you also handle paid ads for healthcare clients?
healthcare_also_handle_paid.answer: Yes. Google Ads and social advertising run alongside SEO so you have demand today while organic and AI visibility compound. Many clients start with paid for speed and shift budget to organic as rankings mature.

healthcare_which_kpis_report.question: Which KPIs do you report for healthcare?
healthcare_which_kpis_report.answer: We report map-pack rankings by service and location, appointment form and call conversions, review count and average rating, featured snippet and ai overview coverage — plus AI visibility tracking that shows how often your brand appears in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.

healthcare_work_manual_safe.question: Is the work manual and safe for healthcare sites?
healthcare_work_manual_safe.answer: Every link, citation and content asset is produced manually. We use no PBNs, no automated link tools and no AI-spun content — critical in a sector where ymyl standards demand verifiable expertise on every page.

healthcare_work_with_our.question: Can you work with our existing healthcare website?
healthcare_work_with_our.answer: Yes. We audit and improve what you have first — most sites gain more from fixing crawlability, structure and content depth than from a rebuild. If a rebuild genuinely pays back, our web team can handle it.
